summary: Renders a second 2D textured quad. Guards on the resource node pointer at this+0xC being non-null, releases the previous single field via SingleFieldFreeWrapper, re-initializes the sub-object at this+4 via ObjectConstructorWithAllocationAndSubInit, and when that constructor reports failure (returns 0) stores the four rectangle parameters into this+0x3C/+0x40/+0x44/+0x48 and emits four vertices through sub_553650 with UV and color arguments.

local_names.this: render node carrying the resource pointer (this+0xC) and quad parameter fields (this+0x3C..0x48)
local_names.a2: quad X parameter, stored to this+0x3C and used as first vertex x
local_names.a3: quad Y parameter, stored to this+0x40 and used as first vertex y
local_names.a4: quad width parameter, stored to this+0x44 and combined into later vertices
local_names.a5: quad height parameter, stored to this+0x48 and combined into later vertices
local_names.a6: scalar passed through to the sub-object constructor

operations.description: Read the resource node pointer at this+0xC; if it is null the whole body is skipped and the read value is returned directly
SingleFieldFreeWrapper(this) releases the previous single field resource before re-rendering
ObjectConstructorWithAllocationAndSubInit(this+4, a6, *(this+12), 32, 192) re-initializes the sub-object; a non-zero (success) return skips the quad render path and returns early
Store the quad parameters into the object: this+0x3C = a2 (X), this+0x40 = a3 (Y), this+0x44 = a4 (Width), this+0x48 = a5 (Height)
Derive the second/third vertex coordinates: v12 = a5 + a3 and v13 = a4 + a2, combining the stored height and width into the remaining quad corners
sub_553650 invoked four times, once per quad vertex, each with a vertex index (0..3), x/y position, RGB color and a -1 trailing argument; the four calls emit the quad corners

Returns the result of the fourth sub_553650 call (vertex 3) on the render path, the constructor result when it succeeds, or the null resource read on the early-exit path; invoked from sub_49CD80 (0049cd80)
